mapper.select: select count(1) from documents where id=#{documentId} and deleted='0'

select count(1) from documents d where d.id=#{documentId} and d.deleted='0' and (d.creator_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from workflow_tasks t join workflow_instances i on i.id=t.instance_id where i.document_id=d.id and (t.assignee_id=#{userId} or t.acted_by=#{userId})))
select current_version from documents where id=#{documentId} and deleted='0'
select id,document_id,version_id,author_id,author_snapshot,content,created_at from document_comments where document_id=#{documentId} order by created_at,id
